I've just published a complete update to my guide on running Agent DVR on a #RaspberryPi 5.
Moving away from the legacy native installer, this new version uses #Docker  Compose for an isolated, robust setup.
I've also included detailed performance benchmarks (CPU & RAM usage under different stream resolutions) and troubleshooting tips for local network device discovery.
🔗 Read the tutorial: https://peppe8o.com/ispy-agent-dvr-raspberry-pi-2/
